title: The Vacant Effigy
subtitle: A body for a resident
text: An empty body for a Fane's resident. The Rite of Hematic Succession raises a new resident in it, and the Rite of Mnemonic Restoration brings a lost one back into it. At Degree 5 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Greater Working floor or larger, seat a Sanguine Formation in the Focus and light an Armor Stand and Blood Stained Stone in the braziers. Feed the frame 250 mL and the floor takes it.
